body: Clean post-#405 release lineage, no normal production code change. This isolated research PR carries the already-merged inert A/B script and a one-shot execution receipt. The A/B is pinned to Gemini 3.8 Flash using the plaintext-h Kʰonapolit route, source verified and released: A full system instructions, B one repeated prosody paragraph removed, with same prompt/history/generation config. Original Google SSE and provider completion will be preserved and compared against TD613 assembly. Bounded at two attempted provider requests, zero retries or fallback, one-day artifact. Exact-head CI execution will be registered with no recurrent spending and removed after observation.
title: research(marrowline): execute one native system-prosody A/B with original Gemini SSE
